comparison.objective: Route a flexible wire between posts while retaining one clip, then seat its final clip; candidate replaces a harness connector while preserving surrounding wiring and seals.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable-cable routing and clip insertion versus an unspecified rigid connector's unlatching, extraction, alignment, and mating; cable management may overlap.
comparison.success_condition: PR measures continuous clip retention, wire continuity, route crossings, bimanual contact, final seating, clearance, and motion; candidate lacks cable geometry, allowed displacement, latch/mating state, seal inspection, and damage thresholds.
comparison.reason: The candidate explicitly includes cable management, but its absent geometry and rubric make it impossible to show whether that ability is more than the routing-and-retention skill already tested here.
